versions.changelog: Publish the pagedrop.ai sharing workflow from the canonical source revision, including the validated Gist publisher and route tests.

Replace the unrelated pagedrop.io uploader with the official pagedrop.ai GitHub Gist workflow; support /g and /h publishing, document revision-pinned and authenticated /s routes, and remove TTL/password/custom-domain claims.
Add PageDrop custom URL and password-protection controls with agent decision guidance and secret-safe password handling.
Remove generated install metadata from the PageDrop sharing release bundle.
Add guarded PageDrop sharing with a bundled uploader and explicit privacy, TTL, fallback, and verification guidance.
Remove selected and focused state shadows from the default fallback theme.
Require offline syntax highlighting for substantial code blocks.
Require auditable style provenance and mandatory fallback theme use when source style is unavailable.
Keep code blocks readable by scoping inline code styles and requiring pre code resets.
